jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**About DEUNA** \uD83E\uDDE1

We are a rapidly growing startup that simplifies global payments and powers next generation commerce in a single platform. With our products we've consolidated hundreds of payment solutions in a single integration, harness an intuitive payment orchestration method and centralize payment reconciliation.

We are currently present all across LATAM and looking for exceptional talent to join our team and continue revolutionizing the world of payments! \uD83D\uDE80

Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on data science leader to own machine learning and experimentation for DEUNA’s payments platform. You will be building the foundations of the data science practice at Deuna, working independently to design, train, and validate models that increase conversion, reduce declines, and reduce fraud in real-time payment flows across merchants and payment providers. You will be a part of the technology organization and will collaborate with project leads who own AI and modeling solutions for our customers, alongside existing data engineering and BI teams who already manage our data foundations and inference services. As DEUNA’s AI efforts grow, so will the team, and this role is a technical leadership role, with potential for people leadership if the skills align.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience applying machine learning to real production problems, ideally in payments, fintech, fraud, or other high-volume transactional environments.
* You think like a research scientist: you start from a problem, decide what data you need, choose the right modeling approach, and define how you will prove it works.
* You have hands-on depth in feature generation, model selection, training, and hyperparameter optimization, and you know when a simple model beats a complex one.
* You have designed and run experiments, including A/B testing and experimentation platforms, and can explain how you validated that a model delivered impact.
* You are proficient in Python and SQL and comfortable querying large datasets in tools like Snowflake. Familiarity with tools such as TensorFlow and Airflow is expected, and you can explain how you have managed and rolled out models.
* You are self-directed. You push for the information you need, and you do not need close supervision to keep work moving.
* You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including setting realistic expectations with leadership about what models can and cannot achieve.
* You have experience in guiding technical infrastructure teams to implement features that enable efficient data science and ML training pipelines and systems

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end modeling lifecycle for DEUNA’s payment optimization use cases: analyze merchant and transaction data, define modeling strategy, generate features, train and tune models, and release them through our existing inference infrastructure.
* Build the experimentation framework we need to measure model performance while collaborating with system and infra engineers, from early signals through month-over-month results, and tie that performance to commitments on our merchant contracts and product pipeline.
* Partner with data teams to define and track building of data processing pipelines that surface insights that shape what DEUNA delivers. You will use experiments and rapid model iteration to tailor approaches to merchant data and goals, and work with the existing models while building new ones.

**What will you find when you join DEUNA?**

* A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM
* Dynamism, agility and constant innovation
* Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region
* The best tools and technology to operate
* Being part of the startup culture.
* We are in full expansion!

**Benefits:**

Vacations and additional PTO \uD83C\uDFDD️

Remote work from anywhere \uD83D\uDCBB

Economic support for internet and cell phone line\uD83D\uDCF1\uD83C\uDF10

We all own DEUNA, we offer stock options \uD83D\uDCB8

Multidisciplinary, diverse and dynamic team \uD83E\uDDE1

Growth and career path \uD83D\uDE80

Be part of a dynamic team that's creating the next generation payments platform.

**Join us at DEUNA!**

DEUNA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value and celebrate diversity and inclusion in our workplace. All employment decisions at DEUNA are made without discrimination based on nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, color, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  

In this role, you will be a part of the system software engineering group and will be responsible for software development and maintenance of on-tool, back-end software module.

  

You will work with a cross-functional team to develop software for our industry leading Laser Scanning Wafer inspection products.

  

Essential Skills:

  
  

* Hands on academic/industrial experience with programing in Java or C++
* Good understanding of Object Oriented Design, Data Structures and Algorithms
* Good problem solving and communication skills
* Ability and interest in learning new skills on the job
  

  

Preferred skills:

  
  

* Scripting languages like Python
* Domain knowledge in one of the following areas; electronic design automation (EDA), Image Processing, Image Computing, Machine Control.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or relevant field and 0 years experience or Bachelor's Level Degree with 2 years experience

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  
  

**Total Rewards**

Base Pay Range: $114,800.00 - $195,200.00 Annually
Primary Location: USA-CA-Milpitas-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.
  
  
Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

  
  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  
  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at +1-408-352-2808 to request accommodation.

  
  

For additional information, view the US Know Your Rights poster on the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission website.

jobs.title: Internal Tool Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Terranova**
-------------------

Terranova is a hard-tech company developing innovative systems to reshape the physical world. We combine mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, and real-world field operations to tackle complex engineering challenges.

We're looking for an **AI Tool Engineer** to help us build smarter, more efficient ways of working across our engineering, manufacturing, and field operations.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an AI Tool Engineer at Terranova, you'll develop practical AI-powered tools, software, and analytical models that improve how our team designs, builds, tests, and operates complex machinery.

This is a highly hands-on role focused on solving real engineering and operational problems. You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software, and field engineers to identify inefficiencies, automate repetitive workflows, and turn operational data into actionable insights.

We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and deploy tools that make a measurable difference in how the company operates.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**AI Tools & Workflow Automation**

* Design and build internal AI-powered tools that streamline engineering, manufacturing, and operational workflows.
* Identify repetitive, manual, or cumbersome processes and develop software solutions to automate them.
* Integrate AI tools with existing engineering software, databases, documentation, and operational systems.
* Build internal applications that help engineers and operators access information, make decisions, and complete tasks more efficiently.

**Data Analysis & Process Optimization**

* Develop systems to collect, track, and analyze metrics across shop operations, equipment performance, and field activities.
* Analyze field injection data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, ground uplift, and operational efficiency.
* Build dashboards, reporting tools, and data pipelines to visualize performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Help quantify engineering and manufacturing processes to establish benchmarks, monitor performance, and reduce inefficiencies.
* Develop models to predict operational outcomes, improve process parameters, and support engineering decisions.

**Modeling & Applied AI**

* Build and deploy machine learning, statistical, and predictive models for engineering applications.
* Use LLMs, AI agents, and other emerging technologies to automate complex workflows and improve internal productivity.
* Develop tools for analyzing experimental results, identifying trends, and optimizing system performance.
* Explore new applications of AI across robotics, manufacturing, equipment monitoring, and field operations.

**Cross-Functional Engineering**

* Work directly with engineers, technicians, and operators to understand challenges and develop practical solutions.
* Take projects from problem identification through prototyping, implementation, and iteration.
* Build lightweight, maintainable tools that can be deployed quickly and improved based on real-world feedback.
* Proactively identify opportunities where software, data, or AI can improve the company's efficiency and capabilities.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building software tools, automation scripts, and data-processing pipelines.
* Experience working with LLM APIs, AI agents, machine learning frameworks, or applied AI systems.
* Ability to build end-to-end applications, from data ingestion and backend logic to simple user interfaces.
* Strong data analysis skills, including SQL, Pandas, and statistical modeling.
* Experience integrating APIs, databases, and third-party software platforms.
* Comfortable working with messy, incomplete, or unstructured real-world data.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently take loosely defined problems and turn them into working solutions.
* Interest in physical engineering systems, manufacturing, robotics, or industrial operations.
* Ability to work closely with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with industrial automation, PLCs, sensors, or equipment telemetry.
* Familiarity with mechanical engineering, fluid systems, hydraulics, or manufacturing processes.
* Experience with time-series data, predictive modeling, or optimization algorithms.
* Experience developing computer vision applications for industrial monitoring or quality control.
* Familiarity with CAD software, engineering simulations, or engineering data pipelines.
* Experience deploying internal tools using modern web frameworks and cloud services.

**Why Terranova?**
------------------

At Terranova, you'll have the opportunity to apply AI to real-world engineering problems rather than building software in isolation. Your work will directly influence how physical systems are designed, manufactured, tested, and operated.

You'll have significant ownership over projects, the freedom to experiment with new technologies, and the ability to see your solutions implemented in the shop and in the field.

We're looking for a builder who enjoys moving quickly, solving ambiguous problems, and using AI and software to make complex engineering operations more efficient.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Network Switching
jobs.description:
At Meta, we're building and operating one of the world's most dynamic and fast-paced networks, powering our global data centers and supporting cutting-edge technologies like AI, Generative AI, Recommendation engines, and Metaverse. Our network infrastructure teams are responsible for developing, deploying, and operating this complex system, covering the entire network lifecycle from hardware development to operation. We're seeking software engineers to join our teams and help build scalable distributed systems, develop innovative solutions to our challenges, and ship them into production. As part of our network engineering teams, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge switching technology, collaborate with engineers, and contribute to the development of Meta's hyper-scale network infrastructure.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer - Network Switching Responsibilities:**

* Your contributions will affect a massive fleet of switches powering both application and AI workloads
* Design, develop, validate, and deploy control-plane and dataplane software for network switches (Meta's network switch OS), for Meta's data center front-end, AI backend, and backbone networks
* Partner with switch ASIC and system vendors on SDK integration, new feature development and platform bring-up
* Engage with network-engineering, routing infrastructure, host networking, transport teams to align on goals, lead integration efforts, and drive continuous development
* Debug complex system-level issues and lead performance tuning exercises to optimize control-plane and dataplane performance
* Partner with network operations and deployment teams for fleet-wide rollouts and incident response
* Develop and automate test suites for the CI/CD framework and various components in collaboration with test infra teams

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 7+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4+ years of experience
* 3+ years relevant experience with network devices and products (routers, switches, adapters, load balancers) and an understanding of network routing protocols in industry settings
* Proficiency in C/C++ and at least one scripting language (Python/Shell Scripting)
* Experience with developing and automating test suites
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., hardware, operations, test infrastructure) to define requirements and deliver integrated solutions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with stream processing or time-series data pipelines for high-volume network telemetry
* Experience with intent-based network management systems
* Experience with network devices (routers, switches, load balancers) and an understanding of network routing protocols
* Experience with software-defined networking (SDN), network operating systems, or network device APIs such as OpenConfig or gNMI

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 1 year of experience with end-to-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).
* 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.
* Experience with mathematics or analytics, with experience analyzing large-scale data.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience designing, training, and launching machine learning or deep learning models in production.
* Experience in ads ranking, conversion rate prediction, recommendation systems, or auction and bidding optimization.
* Experience with mobile advertising measurement, privacy-preserving attribution signals, or learning from sparse, delayed, or biased feedback.
* Ability to drive cross-functional machine learning and measurement projects end-to-end from problem formulation to production launch.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Join the YouTube Ads Machine Learning team to build and scale next-generation conversion prediction models and privacy-safe measurement foundations for YouTube Demand Gen and App Ads on iOS. In this role, you will manage high-impact machine learning and attribution challenges, bridging deep learning modeling, causal/counterfactual evaluation, and privacy-preserving signals to drive revenue and advertiser return on investment (ROI) across YouTube performance ad products.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, train, and launch large-scale deep learning models (such as pCVR, pInstall, pEvent, pValue, and presence models) to improve conversion prediction accuracy and advertiser return on investment (ROI) on iOS.
* Develop and integrate privacy-preserving measurement and attribution signals.
* Diagnose and resolve complex label-bias, calibration, and counterfactual evaluation challenges across online auction and bidding systems.
* Build and maintain scalable ML training, feature engineering, and model-serving pipelines.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Research, and Ads Serving/Bidding infrastructure teams to drive projects end-to-end, from large-scale data analysis and offline prototyping to online A/B experimentation and production launches.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.description:
Software EngineeringMountain View, CA (HQ)

**About X, the Moonshot Factory**

X is a diverse group of inventors and entrepreneurs who build and launch technologies that aim to improve the lives of millions, even billions, of people. Our goal: 10x impact on the world’s most intractable problems, not just 10% improvement. We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup.

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As an early member of our Finance Analytics and Business Intelligence team, you will play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by establishing robust analytics engineering and business intelligence capabilities for our Finance & Accounting organization. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to ensuring accurate financial reporting, streamlining accounting processes, and supporting our financial operations as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

As a founding Data Scientist on Anthropic's Finance Forecasting team, you'll own revenue forecasting models that drive capacity planning and board reporting, build the backtesting and accuracy discipline that makes those forecasts trustworthy, and lead causal measurement work that tells us how much a given launch or event actually moved revenue — turning what is currently a best-guess conversation into a designed, repeatable readout.

We're hiring for two seats on this team, and we expect candidates to lead with depth in either production time-series forecasting or causal inference. Both shapes are first-class; tell us in your application which one feels more like you.

This is a build role on a small team. The forecast is visible inside the company, and when it's wrong, people notice. We're looking for someone who would rather have their models scored than stay vague, and who is excited to set the bar for how forecasting is done here.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own a core piece of the team's modeling work — either the production revenue forecasts themselves (scoping, development, backtesting, deployment, monitoring) or the causal measurement program for launches and events
* Build and run backtesting and accuracy tracking for your models, and use the results to improve quality cycle over cycle
* Contribute to the team's broader research direction, including event-aware forecast architectures, hierarchical reconciliation, and causal designs that hold up under launch-driven step-changes
* Translate model output and accuracy results into clear recommendations for Finance and executive leadership
* Partner with the team's Analytics Engineer on feature pipelines, model deployment, and the forecast store

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Have substantial experience in data science, forecasting, or quantitative finance, including time owning models in production rather than only in notebooks
* Are deeply fluent in Python and SQL and comfortable productionizing what you build
* Have a strong applied statistics foundation, with depth in either production time-series methods (Prophet, ETS, ARIMA, gradient-boosted approaches, neural forecasting, hierarchical reconciliation) or causal inference (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series, event studies)
* Have built backtesting and accuracy-tracking discipline before and are comfortable having your models scored publicly
* Have presented and defended a forecast or causal estimate to executives
* Have a bias for action and do your best work in ambiguous, early-stage environments

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with exogenous-regressor or event-aware forecasting approaches
* Familiarity with hybrid or foundation-model forecasting (TimeGPT-class systems)
* Background in pricing and elasticity modeling or marketing-mix modeling
* Experience forecasting a consumption-based or usage-billed business (cloud, API, marketplace)

jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About Ramp Labs**
-------------------

Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 70,000+ companies use to move money. We think the defensible part of an AI product is the loop: proprietary environments, evals that track what customers care about, and models trained against both.

**About the Role**
------------------

Every model decision at Ramp Labs runs through a benchmark. Which model to route to. Whether a post-training run worked. Whether an agent is ready to post a corrective journal entry to a customer's ledger without a human in the loop.

You'll own Ramp's benchmarking effort. You'll turn real finance work (expense policy review, invoice coding, month-end close, spreadsheet Q&A) into benchmarks and RL environments, build the graders, and tell the team what is actually improving.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Build benchmarks from real workflows: turn agent traces, customer edge cases and expert labels into versioned benchmark suites for long-horizon agents that run for hours across tools and systems, plus tool use, multi-step reasoning and financial judgment
* Own the benchmarking effort: decide what we measure, run benchmark suites across models and agent versions, and report results the team makes decisions on
* Design graders: rubrics, programmatic checks and llm-as-judge, calibrated against human agreement, with a clear view of where each one breaks
* Close the loop with post-training: turn evals into reward functions and RL environments, and catch reward hacking and contamination before they ship
* Publish external benchmarks and write-ups on how models perform at real finance work

**What You Need**
-----------------

* Hands-on experience building LLM benchmarks or evals that people used to make real decisions
* Strong Python and software engineering; your eval code is reproducible and fast
* Statistical judgment: variance, confidence intervals, sample size, inter-rater agreement, and knowing when a delta is noise
* Working knowledge of post-training (SFT, RL with verifiable rewards) and how evals feed into it
* Comfort with SQL and large datasets; you'll work directly from production traces
* Taste for what is worth measuring

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Industry experience on an eval, benchmarking or post-training team
* Built RL environments or verifiers for agentic tasks
* Published benchmark or evaluation research (NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks, ICML, ACL)
* Built or contributed to eval frameworks (verifiers, lm-evaluation-harness, HELM or similar)
* Familiarity with accounting, finance or other expert-domain work
* Public work we can look at: a benchmark, an eval suite, a failure-analysis write-up

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Vercel Connect helps developers give agents and AI-built apps secure access to the data, tools, and events they need—without wrestling with OAuth, credentials, and integration complexity. We’re currently building two things: 1) a platform for managing agent identity, access and permissions and 2) a set of rich connectors for the 1000s of systems (like Linear, Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.) that agents will need to talk to.

We’re solving core problems like agent identity and delegated access, tool approval and standards around making agents aware of changes on 3rd party platforms.

As a senior engineer on this team you'll not only own our APIs, token infrastructure, authorization, SDKs, and more, but work with external companies to make it easier for developers to build agents that integrate with their products. You’ll need to balance both high uptime and fast performance with flexibility to allow for seamless connection to many systems that weren’t designed with agents in mind. If you’re looking for a role that will put you at the center of how agent identity and credentials work, this is it!

* Work with industry leaders within and outside of Vercel to propose and implement new authentication and authorization protocols for AI era

**About Vercel:**

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

**About the role**
------------------

Agents are becoming first-class users of the internet. They sign in, call APIs, deploy code, and act on behalf of people and teams. That raises questions the web was never designed to answer: Who is this agent? Who does it work for? What is it allowed to do, for how long, and how do we know?

As an engineer on the [*Agent Auth and Identity*] team, you'll help answer those questions. You'll build the systems that let agents and people authenticate, delegate access, and act safely across Vercel and the services our customers connect to. This is foundational work: identity and authorization sit underneath everything we ship, and getting them right for agents will shape how modern software gets built.

The scope is intentionally broad. You might spend one quarter designing how credentials are issued and scoped for autonomous agents, and the next building the developer-facing APIs and SDKs that make secure auth feel effortless. You'll own systems end-to-end, from design through long-term operation in production.

We're looking for engineers who care deeply about security and developer experience in equal measure, enjoy working on problems without established playbooks, and want to define how trust works in an agentic world.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design, build, and operate the identity, authentication, and authorization systems that power Vercel and our Customers for both people and agents.
* Shape how agents prove who they are, act on behalf of users and teams, and receive scoped, time-bound, auditable access.
* Build secure, scalable APIs, services, and SDKs that make auth simple for developers and their agents to adopt.
* Work with modern and emerging standards (such as OAuth 2.x, OIDC, and agent-focused protocols) and help influence where they go next.
* Lead projects end-to-end: identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver improvements in security, reliability, and developer experience.
* Partner closely with product, security, and platform teams across Vercel to make identity a strength of every product we ship.

* Solid understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, such as sessions, tokens, OAuth/OIDC flows, permission models, and secrets management.

* A track record of end-to-end ownership, from design and implementation through to long-term operation.

* Strong cross-team collaboration skills and the ability to drive alignment toward shared goals.

We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is growing in maturity, so now is the time to join and drive game-changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. =============

From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will drive the design, development, and operation of a variety of key embedded security capabilities for each satellite throughout its lifetime – from launch to de-orbit.  
  
Develop software to payload Radio and Payload Mode Management. Own unique embedded software functions through design, implementation (in C, C++ or other), test, and integration in an embedded Linux system.  
Work closely with hardware teams to support board design, bring-up, and verification, as well as integration and test.  
Follow best practices in high reliability embedded software development to ensure high levels of satellite security and reliability.  
Work on the Satellite Communication Systems Payload.  
  
A day in the life

### **Job description**

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Sigma Connectivity is a design house with a heritage in mobile phone development at Sony Ericsson and Sony. We are a team of 600 talented engineers with a main office in Lund, Southern Sweden. Primarily, we run in-house projects focused on connected products in consumer electronics and IoT. We have the capability in terms of people, expertise, and labs to realize the most demanding products on the market. In the US, we have operations in San Jose, San Diego, and Seattle. Our San Diego office is close to Palomar Airport in Carlsbad, and our San Jose office is just by the San Jose airport. As a fast-growing company, we are constantly looking for open-minded, talented people who want to join our journey. The Sigma Connectivity company culture is about sharing experiences and knowledge, and with a Scandinavian work culture, we strive for work-life balance and taking care of people. Within Sigma Connectivity, you will never work alone.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Sigma Connectivity is looking for an enthusiastic, hands-on Audio Electrical Engineer. The Wireless Software team builds the cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth software that keeps the vehicles online for over-the-air updates, emergency calling, remote commands, navigation, and streaming. We're hiring a senior cellular software engineer to own key parts of the in-vehicle 5G stack on the telematics platform used across several vehicle brands and shipped to markets worldwide. This is a hands-on IC role on embedded Linux and automotive 5G modems, working directly with modem suppliers, carriers, and our cloud connectivity team.

The points below describe a strong candidate; however, we highly value motivation, work ethic, and enthusiasm

**RESPONSIBILIES**

* Build and own the vehicle-side eSIM client: the GSMA 32 IoT profile assistant that downloads, enables, disables, and deletes carrier profiles on the embedded eUICC, integrated with our cloud eSIM manager (eIM) and connectivity management platform.
* Extend the cellular stack for multi-carrier, multi-region operation: carrier detection by MCC/MNC and per-carrier configuration of APNs, network selection, roaming, and recovery behavior, so new carriers and countries are added through configuration instead of code changes.
* Design and maintain the C++ services that control the modem and data path on embedded Linux, including registration state, concurrent data sessions on separate APNs for vehicle, media, and hotspot traffic, dual-stack IPv4/IPv6, and coordination with Wi-Fi for connection handoff.
* Make connectivity recover without user action: detect data stalls, registration rejects, out-of-service conditions, and modem initialization failures, apply tiered recovery, and keep the modem in a correct state through vehicle sleep, wake, and wake-on-network
* Own cellular observability and field triage: define telemetry for connectivity health, analyze modem diagnostic logs and fleet data, and drive modem and firmware defects to resolution with silicon and module vendors.Support the voice and emergency-call services that run on the cellular stack (IMS registration, emergency calling, SMS), working with the eCall team to root-cause call
* Write design docs and review code for the cellular subteam, mentor engineers, and set technical direction with partners in cloud, hardware and RF, systems engineering, test automation, and homologation.

### **Basic qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of embedded or systems software experience, including 3+ years on device-side cellular (LTE/5G) software that shipped in production devices such as telematics units, IoT modules, or phones.
* Strong modern C++ (C++17 or later) on embedded Linux: multithreaded services, state machines, IPC, and unit testing with GoogleTest/GoogleMock or similar.
* Host-side modem integration through vendor SDKs, QMI, AT commands, MBIM, or an Android RIL.
* Working knowledge of 3GPP device procedures: attach and registration (including reject causes), PDN/PDU sessions and APN configuration, PLMN selection, and roaming.
* Linux networking: IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack, policy routing, iptables/nftables, DNS/DHCP, and packet capture analysis with tcpdump or Wireshark.
* Experience debugging cellular issues from the field using modem diagnostic logs (QXDM/QCAT or equivalent), through to root cause in the application, modem firmware, or network.

**Nice to Have:**

* eSIM development: GSMA SGP.32, SGP.22, or SGP.02; eUICC ES10 interfaces and APDUs; IPA/LPA, SM-DP+, and eIM flows; bootstrap and operational profiles.
* Qualcomm automotive or IoT modem platforms, including the Qualcomm Telematics SDK.
* Carrier certification: carrier acceptance test plans in North America, Europe, or Asia-Pacific; GCF/PTCRB; carrier configuration files (MBN/PRI).
* IMS, VoLTE/VoNR, or emergency calling (eCall, NG-eCall, E911) on the device side.
* Multi-carrier, multi-SIM, or dual-modem products, and steering-of-roaming behavior.
* Automotive or other regulated embedded products: low-power modes, wake-on-network, homologation, and security requirements.
* Cellular test automation with network simulators (Keysight, Rohde & Schwarz, Anritsu, or similar), RF attenuation setups, and Python test frameworks.
* Yocto/BitBake or Bazel build systems.

### **Preferred additional skills, personal traits and experience**

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Ability to work in fast-paced, client-facing environments
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Adaptability to changing requirements and priorities
* Team player
* Proactiveness in collaboration and execution
* Flexibility to switch technical context
* Willingness to learn new methods/tools/processes
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and take ownership
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

jobs.title: Robotics Research Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Robotics Research Engineer on our Robotics team, you'll design, train, and evaluate robotics policies from imitation learning to reinforcement learning to foundation/VLA models using Zeromatter's simulation platform, then validate, and iterate against real hardware. This work is grounded in real customer use cases as much as internal research goals. The manipulation and automation tasks you train and validate often trace directly back to a problem a customer is trying to solve. You'll work closely with our Dynamics team, who own Physics Engine development, to make sure the simulator keeps pace with what policy training needs. You'll be running the experiments, in sim and in the lab, that push our simulator's fidelity and our policies' transfer performance forward together. Responsibilities may vary from month to month, but here are some examples of things you might find yourself working on.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design and run experiments training robotics policies (imitation learning, reinforcement learning, VLA models, etc.) entirely or primarily in simulation.
* Work hands-on with physical robots (e.g. bimanual manipulator arms) to collect real-world data, validate sim-trained policies, and characterize the sim-to-real gap.
* Collaborate with our Dynamics team to identify simulation fidelity gaps that limit transfer performance, and help prioritize and validate fixes.
* Build and maintain data pipelines and evaluation frameworks/benchmarks for policy training and transfer performance.
* Prototype new tasks and domains (e.g. dexterous manipulation, cross-embodiment transfer), often grounded in real customer use cases, to expand what Zeromatter's platform can demonstrate.
* Read, evaluate, and adapt techniques from state-of-the-art robot learning research for use on Zeromatter's platform.
* Contribute findings and results to customer-facing technical materials and demonstrations.
* Build reusable libraries and tooling (in Python, Rust, and/or C++) to support this work at scale.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* You have an engineering or related technical degree (e.g. robotics, computer science, mechanical/electrical engineering, physics) or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Experience training and evaluating robot learning policies (imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and/or foundation/VLA models) gained in industry, in a research lab, or through graduate/postdoctoral work.
* Hands-on experience working with physical robots including collecting data, running experiments, and debugging real-world hardware/software issues.
* Proficient in Python, Rust, and/or C++, with experience in ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
* Comfortable working with incomplete information, iterating quickly between simulation and real-world validation.
* Familiarity with the practical challenges of sim-to-real transfer (e.g. domain randomization, system identification, observation/action space design, adaptation).
* Bonus: Experience with dexterous manipulation or other contact-rich manipulation tasks.
* Bonus: Experience with cross-embodiment policy learning or transfer across robot platforms.
* Bonus: Experience with teleoperation systems and data collection pipelines.
* Bonus: Experience working end-to-end across the robotics stack, including perception, classical and learned control systems, task planning, etc.
* Bonus: Familiarity with physics/dynamics simulation engines (e.g. MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or custom/proprietary engines).
* Bonus: Publication record or open-source contributions in robot learning, embodied AI, or manipulation.

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Our technical teams rack, power, cool, cable, configure, and troubleshoot the GPU clusters that customers train and serve models on.

We are hiring an AI Infrastructure Engineer to be the technical depth of that team. This role spans the full stack of a GPU deployment: you will install and commission the hardware, configure the Linux hosts and the InfiniBand or RoCE fabric that connects them, and own the Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets that no one else can close. When a node fails repeatedly, you are the person who finds out why.

This is a hands-on role. You will still be in the aisle with a torque wrench during deployment windows. You will also write the runbook that prevents the next escalation, tune the fabric that shaved 8% off a customer’s job time, and sit in the vendor call explaining why their firmware is the root cause.

The work is hybrid. Deployment windows, hardware break-fix, and physical layer work happen on site. Configuration, diagnostics, ticket ownership, automation, and documentation can happen from wherever you work best.

What you’ll do

Escalation and root cause ownership

* Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets end to end — accept escalations from Tier 1 and support teams, drive them to resolution, and close them with a documented cause rather than a reboot.

* Perform root cause analysis on server hardware failures: correlate IPMI/BMC event logs, MCE and EDAC records, kernel messages, thermal and power telemetry, and vendor diagnostics to distinguish a genuine component failure from firmware, configuration, environmental, or workload causes.

* Identify recurring failure patterns across the fleet — a DIMM slot that fails repeatedly, a firmware revision correlated with GPU falloff, a rack with marginal airflow — and drive the systemic fix.

* Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews; translate findings into monitoring, runbook, and standards changes.

* Serve as the technical escalation point for vendors: build the evidence package, defend the diagnosis, and manage RMA and field-service engagements through to closure.

* Communicate directly with customers during open incidents and maintenance windows, not only after the fact: status while the issue is live, the notice before a window, and the confirmation after it closes. Concise and factual, with no speculation about cause before it is established.

* Direct colocation remote hands in writing, to the level of cabinet, rack unit, port, and cable label, and verify the result remotely before accepting the work as done.

* Participate in a shared on-call rotation for infrastructure incidents.

**GPU systems and troubleshooting**

* Administer and troubleshoot GPU compute nodes — NVIDIA H100/H200/B200/B300 SXM and PCIe platforms, AMD Instinct, or comparable accelerators.

jobs.title: VLA/WAM Research Engineer
jobs.description:
At Flexion, we're building the intelligence layer powering the next generation of humanoid robots. Our mission is to accelerate the transition from fragile prototypes to real-world humanoid deployment. We are founded by leading scientists in robot reinforcement learning (ex-Nvidia, ex-ETH Zürich), and backed by leading international VC firms. In just months, we’ve gone from our first line of code to deploying real humanoid capabilities.

### **The role**

As our VLA/WAM Research Engineer, you'll develop the foundation models that power our humanoid robots, spanning model architecture, large-scale pre-training, adaptation, and post-training.

You will work across the model lifecycle: designing VLA and World-Action Model architectures, training foundation models on large and diverse embodied datasets, developing methods for efficient adaptation to new tasks and embodiments, and using robot experience to continuously improve model capabilities.

In particular, we are looking for researchers and engineers with deep experience in one or more of the following areas: VLA/VLM or multimodal model architecture, large-scale foundation-model pre-training, world models and predictive learning, robot learning, or post-training and continual learning. If you have strong depth in one of these areas and are excited to work across the broader problem of building general-purpose robot foundation models, you will be a strong fit for the role.

### **Key responsibilities**

* VLA/WAM Architecture: Design and develop multimodal foundation models combining vision, language, robot state, actions, and temporal context for general-purpose robotic control.
* Foundation Model Pretraining: Develop and execute large-scale pretraining across diverse robot embodiments, teleoperation, egocentric human data, and simulated experience.
* Training Recipes & Scaling: Improve data mixtures, training objectives, optimization strategies, and distributed training workflows to deliver increasingly capable foundation models on a regular cadence.
* World-Action Models: Develop predictive world and action models for representation learning, future-state prediction, planning, and robot policy improvement.
* Adaptation & Mid-training: Develop methods to efficiently adapt pretrained models to new tasks, environments, embodiments, and capabilities.
* Post-training & Reinforcement Learning: Improve models using real-world and simulated robot experience, including imitation learning, RL, reward/value-guided learning, and specialist-to-generalist distillation.
* Continual Learning: Develop methods to learn from autonomous rollouts, failures, interventions, and recoveries while retaining existing capabilities and avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
* Evaluation & Research: Design rigorous experiments, evaluate models in simulation and on real robots, and use results to guide architecture and training decisions.

  
**Requirements**  

* Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with hands-on experience developing and training modern deep-learning models.
* Research or engineering experience in one or more of the following: VLA/VLM architectures, multimodal foundation models, world models, large-scale pretraining, robot learning, or RL/post-training.
* Experience owning substantial model development or training experiments, including architecture choices, training objectives, optimization, and evaluation.
* Solid understanding of modern deep-learning architectures, representation learning, and the relationship between data, training objectives, and model performance.
* Ability to design rigorous experiments, diagnose training failures, and use empirical results to guide research decisions.
* Familiarity with large-scale datasets, model training workflows, and the challenges of generalization across tasks, environments, or embodiments.
* Ability to critically evaluate recent research and translate promising ideas into working models and experiments.
* Comfortable working across model architecture, training, and adaptation while bringing particular expertise in at least one of these areas.

**Additionally, the following are a plus but not required:**

* Experience training VLA, VLM, diffusion, flow-matching, video/world models, or other multimodal generative architectures.
* Experience with distributed training, multi-node GPU systems, large-scale data mixtures, and foundation-model training optimization.
* Experience with reinforcement learning, offline RL, reward/value learning, specialist distillation, or continual learning.
* Experience with predictive world models, video generation, latent dynamics, or self-supervised representation learning.
* Experience with multi-embodiment robot learning, action representations, or adapting policies across different robot platforms.
* Experience working with teleoperation, egocentric video, simulation, autonomous rollouts, or other large-scale embodied datasets.
* Experience evaluating learned policies on real robots, particularly humanoids or dexterous manipulation systems.

### **The Position**

**Biostatistician**
===================

**Department Summary**

This role is within Biostatistics, a core function within Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. Biostatistics identifies opportunities to apply the full breadth of data, digital, and design capabilities to deploy innovative methods across PDD, PD and the broader Roche Pharma organization.

As trusted analytical partners in end-to-end drug development, Biostatistics leverages data to drive scientifically rigorous programmatic decisions across Roche’s Development portfolio; Biostatistics designs robust trials and analysis plans that increase the probability of technical success, accelerating timelines to advance Roche’s clinical pipeline and promote regulatory success — ultimately bringing medicines to our patients faster.

This position is based in **South San Francisco, on site**.

**The Opportunity**

The Statistician is a key member of the cross-functional study or molecule team, responsible for applying statistical expertise to the design, conduct, analysis, and interpretation of individual clinical trials. This role ensures the scientific rigor and regulatory compliance of the study by contributing to protocol development, authoring statistical analysis plans, performing or overseeing data analyses, and supporting the interpretation and communication of results. The Statistician plays a critical role in ensuring that each study generates robust, meaningful data to support decision-making and regulatory submissions.

  

* You contribute to trial design under guidance, applying standard statistical methods.
* You draft and review protocols, statistical analysis plans (SAPs), and case report forms (CRFs) using templates and precedents.

* You hold a PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a closely related quantitative field.

Arup works on some of the world's most complex challenges across the built and natural environment, from designing the infrastructure and cities of the future to improving how critical systems operate today.

Artificial intelligence is opening up new ways to address these challenges. We are investing in our AI and machine learning capabilities to explore what is possible, develop innovative approaches and deliver practical solutions for our clients.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and real-world engineering, alongside specialists from across Arup's global business. You'll have access to interesting problems, the freedom to explore new ideas and the opportunity to shape how AI is applied across our projects and markets.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an ambitious and curious AI/ML Engineer to play a key role in developing and delivering our AI capabilities across the Americas.

Above all, we want someone who is excited by problems and the potential of AI to solve them. Someone who enjoys working with engineers, scientists, designers and consultants to understand complex challenges, recognise where new technologies could make a difference, and turn those opportunities into practical solutions.

The role spans applications across infrastructure, energy, transport, water, buildings and the environment. You might be developing predictive models for critical infrastructure, applying computer vision to understand the physical world, using generative AI to transform engineering workflows, or exploring entirely new approaches to longstanding challenges.

You will be a key technical member of our growing AI/ML team, with the opportunity to lead projects, shape technical approaches and develop junior colleagues.

We also want someone who embraces the changing nature of software development. We encourage the use of AI-assisted coding, agents and emerging development tools to accelerate experimentation, improve productivity and rethink how technical solutions are built. You'll have the opportunity to explore these tools, bring new approaches into our work and help others adopt them effectively.

* **Lead AI/ML projects:** Take technical ownership of projects from identifying opportunities and developing concepts through to building, validating and deploying solutions.

* **Embrace AI-assisted development:** Make effective use of AI coding assistants, agents and emerging tools to accelerate development, experiment with new ideas and improve how we deliver technical work, while maintaining quality and technical rigour.
* **Develop our team:** Mentor junior engineers and data scientists, provide technical guidance, share knowledge and help build a collaborative and ambitious technical team.
* **Shape our AI capability:** Contribute to client discussions, proposals, technical strategy and the development of reusable solutions that can be applied across projects and markets.

This is a role with considerable variety, autonomy and opportunity to grow. You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional approaches, explore emerging technologies and help define how Arup uses AI to solve some of the most important challenges facing our clients and communities.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.

You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

**Is this role right for you?**

We are particularly interested in people who are motivated by the potential of AI, enjoy tackling unfamiliar problems and want to take responsibility for technical delivery and developing others.

* **Background and experience:** A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, data science or a related field, with typically 5+ years of relevant experience applying AI/ML to practical problems, including experience leading technical work.
* **Strong technical skills:** Proficiency in Python and modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn, alongside experience with data engineering, cloud technologies and deploying models into practical applications.
* **Curiosity and adaptability:** A broad interest in AI technologies, including predictive modelling, computer vision, large language models, generative AI and agentic systems. Enthusiasm for using AI-assisted development tools and experimenting with new ways of working.
* **Problem-solving and communication:** The ability to understand unfamiliar technical challenges, work with specialists from different backgrounds and translate complex ideas into clear, practical solutions.
* **Leadership and collaboration:** Experience taking ownership of technical projects, mentoring junior colleagues and working collaboratively to deliver high-quality outcomes.

We value intellectual curiosity, practical judgement and a willingness to tackle difficult problems as much as expertise in any individual technology. We are looking for someone who wants to keep learning, enjoys building things and is excited about what AI could make possible.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Benchmarks & Evaluation
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About Ramp Labs**
-------------------

Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 70,000+ companies use to move money. We think the defensible part of an AI product is the loop: proprietary environments, evals that track what customers care about, and models trained against both.

**About the Role**
------------------

Every model decision at Ramp Labs runs through a benchmark. Which model to route to. Whether a post-training run worked. Whether an agent is ready to post a corrective journal entry to a customer's ledger without a human in the loop.

You'll own Ramp's benchmarking effort. You'll turn real finance work (expense policy review, invoice coding, month-end close, spreadsheet Q&A) into benchmarks and RL environments, build the graders, and tell the team what is actually improving.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Build benchmarks from real workflows: turn agent traces, customer edge cases and expert labels into versioned benchmark suites for long-horizon agents that run for hours across tools and systems, plus tool use, multi-step reasoning and financial judgment
* Own the benchmarking effort: decide what we measure, run benchmark suites across models and agent versions, and report results the team makes decisions on
* Design graders: rubrics, programmatic checks and llm-as-judge, calibrated against human agreement, with a clear view of where each one breaks
* Close the loop with post-training: turn evals into reward functions and RL environments, and catch reward hacking and contamination before they ship
* Publish external benchmarks and write-ups on how models perform at real finance work

**What You Need**
-----------------

* Hands-on experience building LLM benchmarks or evals that people used to make real decisions
* Strong Python and software engineering; your eval code is reproducible and fast
* Statistical judgment: variance, confidence intervals, sample size, inter-rater agreement, and knowing when a delta is noise
* Working knowledge of post-training (SFT, RL with verifiable rewards) and how evals feed into it
* Comfort with SQL and large datasets; you'll work directly from production traces
* Taste for what is worth measuring

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Industry experience on an eval, benchmarking or post-training team
* Built RL environments or verifiers for agentic tasks
* Published benchmark or evaluation research (NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks, ICML, ACL)
* Built or contributed to eval frameworks (verifiers, lm-evaluation-harness, HELM or similar)
* Familiarity with accounting, finance or other expert-domain work
* Public work we can look at: a benchmark, an eval suite, a failure-analysis write-up

**Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

**Referral Instructions**
-------------------------

**Other notices**
-----------------

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**The Role**
------------

This is not a ticket-grinder role. You're not here to implement Figma specs, collect your JIRA points, and wait for the next sprint planning. You're here to move fast, make real calls, and ship things that matter. You'll be one of a small number of engineers working directly on the highest-leverage features on our platform: intelligent intake flows, AI-powered case routing, constituent-facing portals that replace decade-old government interfaces.

You'll pair with design leadership that cares deeply about craft and won't let you ship something half-baked. You'll engage directly with federal agency stakeholders. You'll translate what government users actually need into a product that delivers it.

And you'll be expected to use AI tooling not as a party trick, but as a force multiplier. Cursor, Claude, Copilot: these should already be embedded in how you think and work. The engineers we're hiring here move 3 to 5x faster because of how deeply they've internalized these tools. That's the bar.

**Location**
------------

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York or DC office. Candidates must reside or be able to commute to New York City or DC to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday to Thursday).

We’re unable to sponsor visas for this role.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Full-stack features from zero to shipped: scoping, architecture, build, iteration
* AI-powered product surfaces: intelligent intake flows, real-time constituent assistants, automated case routing, agency operator dashboards
* Direct engagement with federal agency stakeholders, translating messy real-world requirements into clean, shippable product
* Platform reliability and performance at government scale: real users, real SLAs, no hiding
* Code quality that the next engineer will respect: clean, tested, maintainable

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 2 to 4 years of professional engineering experience, or work that makes the years irrelevant
* Deep fluency in React / Next.js and Node.js / TypeScript / Postgres: not just comfortable, but fast
* AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude) are already baked into how you work. You're not planning to explore them someday; you've shipped with them
* Something real you've built: a product, an open source project, a thing you couldn't stop working on
* You operate well with ambiguity. You don't wait to be handed the answer.
* You actually care whether the person on the other end of the screen has a good experience

**Strong Candidates May Also...**
---------------------------------

* You've touched federal, state, or local government tech, or you understand the constraints of building for regulated, high-stakes environments
* Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry or AIP: you've modeled against the ontology or shipped pipelines or AIP agents
* Cloud deployment experience (AWS, Vercel, GitHub Actions, ECS/Fargate)
* Exposure to design systems and component libraries: you know the difference between a component that's functional and one that's right
* You've worked in an early-stage environment where figuring it out was the job

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch while in the office.
* Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm.
* Company-provided laptop of your choice.

**Wellness**

* NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us.
* Non-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement.

**Stipends**

jobs.description:
**A World-Changing Company**

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

### **The Role**

Palantir's Defense Applied AI product team builds products that help the modern warfighter leverage AI for their most mission-critical work. You will help own the entire end to end Agent experience in our products and work relentlessly to ensure they deliver value for our users, while maintaining a high bar for quality.  
  
Your day-to-day workflow will vary, adapting to the requirements of our users and the technical challenges that arise. One day, you may find yourself collaborating with users to refine the UX of a particular workflow, the next you could be fine-tuning performance to enable low-latency or more accurate operational outcomes.  
  
Our Product Development organization is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product and work collaboratively to build cross functional capabilities, streamline user workflows and continuously improve our software's efficiency and reliability.  
  
We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable AI products, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them.

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Design and build AI agents that help defense and intelligence users investigate complex questions, analyze operational data, develop plans, and produce actionable work
* Relentlessly focus on improving agent experience through data-driven evals across memory, tool and skill design, context management, fine-tuning, and more
* Actively improve user workflows by collaborating with cross-functional teams, ensuring seamless experiences across product boundaries and a cohesive user experience
* Build intuitive interfaces that let users direct agents, follow their progress, inspect supporting evidence, review proposed actions, and refine the resulting work
* Own features from early experimentation through production deployment, working with users, designers, and engineers to turn specific mission needs into reliable, reusable product capabilities
* Optimizing applications for speed and scalability through performance analysis and with high-scale, complex data

### **What We Value**

* Strong product instincts and attention to the details that make complex software intuitive and useful
* Ability to communicate and collaborate with a variety of individuals, including engineers, users and non-technical team members
* Experience building applications with LLMs, including tool design, context management, agent workflows, or evaluation
* Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, the ability to ask questions effectively, and the skills to iterate directly with users and own core outcomes
* Curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and sound judgment about where they can solve real user problems
